item.title: ErgoDox Split Ergonomic Keyboard Review
item.description:
The ErgoDox is a DIY ergonomic keyboard, featuring a split design—each half, one hand. The two halves are connected with a phone TRRS connector cable, while the connection to the PC—or Mac or Unix—is obtained through a detachable mini USB.

History

The project has been initiated by Dominic Beauchamp—aka Dox, from which the keyboard name derives—on the GeekHack.org forum; the design has been largely inspired by the Key64 project by Nestor Diaz.
